title: Shaft speed ambiguous and near Nyquist — fault orders not conclusive
summary: Speed posterior is multimodal: MAP 198.0 rpm p=0.389 (68% CI 197.4–198.3 rpm), alternatives 209.0 rpm p=0.256, 222.2 rpm p=0.214, 187.1 rpm p=0.141; p_map 0.389 <0.8. This conflicts with audio blade-pass track 12.41 Hz / 744.6 rpm. Induction-motor and 8-pole what-ifs did not resolve it (MAP still 198.0 rpm, p_map 0.395 and 0.400). 12.41 Hz is near 15.0 Hz Nyquist (fps 30, near_nyquist_warning true), so aliasing is possible. No display_rpm check available. Do not conclude 1x/imbalance from this track; need tachometer/strobe or higher-fps/higher-sample-rate capture with nameplate poles/blade count.

title: Amplitudes uncalibrated — no ISO 20816 severity can be reported
summary: scale_calibrated=false and iso_zone=null despite channel relative RMS values 1628 (s1 motor housing), 1745 (s2 motor base frame), 1789 (s3 electrical cabinet) which are physically implausible as mm/s. Per scale note, amplitudes are relative only; do NOT use ISO zones or absolute mm/s severity. Conclusions limited to frequencies, orders, phase and ratios. 1x relative order amplitude reported 15.159 with 2x=0 and 3x=0 at the suspect 12.41 Hz track, but shaft identity is unresolved. Need a calibrated accelerometer capture with known scale/mounting.

title: Evaluable faults are low probability; key faults not evaluable
summary: Evaluable: looseness P=0.0043 (0 shaft harmonics 1–10x above 10 dB, -8.7 dB; half-order 3.6 dB, -4.3 dB), resonance P=0.0295 (forcing-to-mode separation 0.388, -6.5 dB), cavitation P=0.0340 (index 0.237, -3.9 dB; HF energy fraction 0.059, kurtosis -0.068; audio cavitation_like=false, no crackle/impacts). No evidence for looseness, resonance or cavitation. Imbalance (P=0.15 prior), misalignment (0.10), flow (0.10), bearing (0.08) and rotor-bar (0.05) are evaluable:false — no conclusion possible. Needed: phase-referenced radial/axial spectra at both bearing housings and across the coupling at verified shaft speed, plus high-frequency enveloping for bearing, to make those evaluable.

title: Structural modes at ~2.3 Hz and 10.78 Hz, resonance not indicated
summary: Residual mode 2.344 Hz ±0.234 Hz, zeta unknown. FDD: 2.227 Hz, sv_ratio 10.92, phases housing 0°, base frame 42.08°, cabinet 3.26°; and 10.781 Hz, zeta 0.0865 (8.65%), sv_ratio 10.42, phases -2.60°, 0°, 0.35° (in-phase). Campbell criticals list is empty and resonance posterior P=0.0295 with separation 0.388; optimiser p_res_current=0.0 vs threshold 0.05. No order-crossing/resonance conclusion — low-mode damping is unmeasured and speed is unresolved, so verify with a coast-down/run-up or impact test at verified speed.

title: Optimisation infeasible — no setpoint proposed
summary: run_optimiser (duty_min_frac 0.80, resonance_margin 0.10) returned feasible=false, feasible_band_rpm=[], exclusion band 126.56–154.69 rpm, reason 'no speed satisfies duty, resonance and severity constraints', at current 744.62 rpm. text:
## Assessment: inconclusive — no setpoint change proposed

**1. Shaft speed is unresolved**
- Bayesian speed MAP: **198.0 rpm, p=0.389** (68% CI 197.4–198.3 rpm); alternatives 209.0 rpm (p=0.256), 222.2 rpm (p=0.214), 187.1 rpm (p=0.141). p_map 0.389 < 0.80 — ambiguous.
- Audio blade-pass track instead gives **12.41 Hz / 744.6 rpm**, close to the **15.0 Hz Nyquist** (30 fps, near-Nyquist warning active) — aliasing possible.
- Induction-motor and 8-pole what-ifs did not resolve this: MAP remained 198.0 rpm, p_map 0.395 / 0.400. No display_rpm available as an independent check. Fault orders therefore cannot be trusted.

**2. Amplitudes are uncalibrated**
- `scale_calibrated=false`, ISO zone = null. Channel values (1628 / 1745 / 1789) are physically implausible as mm/s — treat as **relative only**. No ISO 20816 severity or absolute mm/s conclusion is reported.

**3. Faults**
- Evaluable and low: looseness **P=0.004** (0 harmonics 1–10× above 10 dB), resonance **P=0.030** (forcing-to-mode separation 0.388), cavitation **P=0.034** (index 0.237; HF fraction 0.059; audio shows no crackle, impacts or rubbing — consistent with Muse's "large 3.3 kV motor under load" description).
- **Not evaluable** (prior-only, no conclusion): imbalance, misalignment, blade-pass/flow, bearing, rotor-bar.

**4. Structure**
- Modes at **2.34 Hz ±0.23 Hz** (damping unknown) and FDD **2.23 Hz** (sv ratio 10.9) and **10.78 Hz, ζ=8.65%** (sv ratio 10.4, in-phase across housing/base/cabinet). No Campbell criticals listed; no resonance indicated, but the 2.3 Hz damping is unmeasured.

**5. Optimisation**
- Optimiser (duty ≥0.80, resonance margin 0.10): **feasible = false**, feasible band empty, exclusion band 126.6–154.7 rpm, at the suspect 744.6 rpm track; its 0.1 kW is implausible for a 3.3 kV machine. Audio indicates steady speed with no evidence of a variable-speed drive. **No `propose_setpoint` was sent.**

**Required for a conclusive assessment:** tachometer/strobe or display-rpm verification; nameplate poles/rated rpm/kW and driven-machine blade count; calibrated accelerometer capture (radial + axial, both bearing housings, phase across the coupling) with Nyquist well above 10× shaft frequency; and a run-up/coast-down to confirm the 2.3 Hz mode and damping.
